messages:
elaine: Reporting a small class of misattributed requests in the console. Projectless key owner shows as Org A in request details but console counts them for Org B. Likely header bleed on keep-alive. Repro below.

elaine: repro:
```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer projless_abc" -H "X-Request-ID: r-321" -H "X-Org: org-b" \
  https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{\"prompt\":\"ping\"}'
```
Edge response includes `X-Org: org-b` but auth metadata says owner=org-a. Console shows metric under org-b.

jeff: This is the keep-alive / affinity fast-path we added. If auth enrichment is skipped, stale client headers can leak.

sara: Two options: (1) always overwrite X-Org after auth (safe but adds p99); (2) auth-service emits an internal header `X-Internal-Owner` signed with HMAC and edge validates it, then telemetry prefers that when FF on. I prefer (2) for perf.

jeff: Agreed. Implementation notes: auth-service resolves owner for projectless keys and sets `X-Internal-Owner: org-a` with `X-Auth-Sig: hmac256(<owner>|<request_id>)`. Edge strips client X-Org before validation, verifies HMAC against rotated secret, then populates `X-Telemetry-Owner`.

elaine: Important: strip any incoming `X-Internal-Owner` and `X-Telemetry-Owner` from clients to avoid spoofing. If HMAC verification fails, increment `auth_signature_failures` and fall back to current behavior.

ux: Console UX: show a tiny badge on request detail when observed_owner != asserted_owner: "observed: org-b | asserted: org-a" with a link to sample logs. That will help triage.

jeff: Telemetry: emit `attribution_conflict_total` and `attribution_conflict_samples` (up to N request_ids + both owners to S3) during canary. Also add `attribution_delta_pct` per org.

sara: Rollout plan: feature-flag `prefer_internal_owner` default off. Canary 5% internal for 6h, monitor conflict metrics, quota deltas, and support tickets. If <0.1% unexpected deltas, move to 30% sandbox 24h, then 100%. Rollback by toggling FF.

ops-bot: deploy-scheduler: Canary window reserved 2026-04-12 02:00-05:00 UTC. Notifying oncall.

infra-bot: infra: PRs please include smoke tests for HMAC spoofing attempts; invalid sig -> increment `auth_signature_failures`.

jeff: I'll own the edge change + FF. Sara will add header signing in auth-service and the HMAC rotation logic. Elaine will coordinate telemetry and the console badge. UX will mock the badge.

sara: PRs: https://git.example/redwood/auth/pulls/980 (header+hmac) and https://git.example/redwood/edge/pulls/624 (edge validation + FF).

elaine: QA to add verification that console attribution equals asserted_owner when FF on for sampled keys. Also verify no client header spoofing possible.

ux: I'll attach a small mock for the badge in the rollout doc.

jeff: Thanks team. We'll sync after first 6h canary to decide promote/rollback. :thumbsup:
